sloka: ततो दिव्यममोघं तं जग्राह शरमुत्तमम् ।ज्वलन्तं तेजसा घोरं पूरयन्तं दिशो दश ।। ७.६९.१७ ॥
transliteration: tato divyamamoghaṁ taṁ jagrāha śaramuttamam ।jvalantaṁ tejasā ghoraṁ pūrayantaṁ diśo daśa ।। 7.69.17 ॥

translations.english: Then he took that excellent, divine, and unfailing arrow, which was blazing with dreadful splendor and filling all ten directions.
